Copies a project's node template into a catalog published from here.

The template's own files come across untouched; its configuration is
rewritten so the id belongs to this catalog and no secret is carried over,
and the library versions it pins are brought in alongside it. Nothing is
published by this - the catalog is committed locally, and Publish is what
sends it to the repository.
